external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: Library member who uses the app or a self-service kiosk to borrow, renew, reserve, or return books.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk staff who use the circulation page to change loan and member-account records.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand
external_entities.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login for the circulation page.

processes.name: app
processes.description: Library app on a member's phone that calls the lending API for borrowing, renewal, and reservation actions.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: self-service kiosk
processes.description: Branch kiosk where a member scans their library card and books being borrowed or returned.
processes.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.

processes.name: lending API
processes.description: REST API that checks loan rules, changes loans and reservations, and serves the circulation page.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: The written note says the lending API is internal-only, but the interview states that phones talk straight to it over the internet. Priya was uncertain about the token check: "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in" and "I could not tell you today what it accepts".

data_stores.name: loans database
data_stores.description: Database containing members, loans, reservations, names, email addresses, home addresses, and full borrowing histories.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.
data_stores.notes: The interview corrects the earlier statement about two databases: "We merged those in the spring. It's one loans database now. The old reservations database is gone."

data_flows.name: borrow renew reserve
data_flows.description: A member uses the library app to request borrowing, renewal, or reservation actions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
data_flows.data_description: Book and member details, and reservation requests.

data_flows.name: scan card and books
data_flows.description: A member scans their library card and books at a self-service kiosk.
data_flows.source_excerpt: a member scans their card and their books at a kiosk in the branch

data_flows.name: change loans
data_flows.description: The app calls the lending API with book and member details for borrowing, renewal, or reservation.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.notes: Priya said, "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in", but stated she could not confirm what the API accepts.
data_flows.data_description: Book, member, loan, and reservation request data.

data_flows.name: send loans and returns
data_flows.description: The kiosk sends each scanned loan and return to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.
data_flows.data_description: Loan and return records associated with members and books.

data_flows.name: change account and loan
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page to extend loans, clear account blocks, and mark books returned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: someone at the desk opens the circulation page and marks it returned, or clears the block on the account.
data_flows.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login, and the password is on a card taped under the desk.

data_flows.name: read-write loans
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Members, loans, reservations, contact details, addresses, and borrowing histories.

trust_boundaries.name: phone
trust_boundaries.description: Member phone environment where the library app runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

trust_boundaries.name: branch network
trust_boundaries.description: Network where branch kiosks and desk staff operate.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: Council data-centre environment where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database is classified as confidential.
assumptions.basis: The database contains names, email addresses, home addresses, and full borrowing histories, which are personal data.

assumptions.assumption: The phone boundary is a tenant boundary because the app runs on a member's phone rather than in the council environment.
assumptions.basis: The source describes the app as running on "their phone" and the phones as directly contacting the council's lending API.
